neighbours.label: The split-off final piece of a device noun, the agentive -er or -izer that the tokenizer separates (steril-izer, div-iders, analy-ser, ext-ender); device nouns that are one token stay quiet

Wooden dividers separate the desks in the open office.
Add a stabilizer to the mix so that the cream holds its shape.
Apply a light moisturizer to your face each morning.
A meat tenderizer hung on a hook above the stove.
The gas analyser measures carbon dioxide in the chamber.
The humidifier in the bedroom helps with her cough.

short: split-off -izer/-er piece of a device noun
notes: Card: 'izer' x8, 'iders' x5, 'iter' x5, 'zers' x4, 'ser', 'ender'. The + pole has dr-'aper', ' baker', so it looks like one side of an -er split. Probe: 'ser' of analyser 1.04, 'iders' 0.81, 'ender' 0.65; whole tokens fertilizer 0.00, sanitizer 0.13, organizer 0.12, printer 0.00. Tokenizer checked for each fire word. ' humid'+'ifier' is the one fire word whose ending was not in the top examples.
